name: Henan Tong-Da Cable Co., Ltd.
summary: Henan Tong-Da Cable Co., Ltd., based in Yanshi, China, and established in 1987, is a prominent manufacturer specializing in the research, development, and production of a diverse range of wires and cables. The company's product line includes specialized wires for electrified railway systems, such as ground, cloth, and contact wires, alongside various cables like power, overhead insulated, fireproof, load-bearing, control, and DC cables tailored for rail transit. Additionally, they offer solutions for home improvement and an array of advanced wire types, including steel core aluminum strand and alloy, heat-resistant steel core, expanded diameter, aluminum clad steel strand and core, aluminum alloy stranded and core, carbon fiber composite, and steel core soft aluminum strand wires. Demonstrating a significant international presence, Henan Tong-Da Cable Co., Ltd. exports its products to more than 80 countries globally.
